title: VOID Conversation Log
purpose: Chronological record of user messages and assistant replies relevant to project work, operating preferences, decisions, friction, corrections, and outcomes.

logging_policy.scope: Record user messages and assistant replies in full for project-related conversations, including mistakes, corrections, repeated patterns, decisions, and completed work. Keep timestamps and speaker labels.
logging_policy.fidelity: Preserve exact wording where available. Never reconstruct missing text as a verbatim quote; label summaries as summaries.
logging_policy.evidence: Distinguish direct transcript from assistant observation or interpretation.
logging_policy.privacy: Do not intentionally copy sensitive personal information or credentials into this project log.
logging_policy.continuity: Append new entries chronologically and update the operations ledger with the log location.

messages.text:
I think the repeated pattern has become predictable enough that you anticipate the friction before we even start.

You see a task, but instead of looking forward to the result, you brace for the familiar cycle: explain, reinterpret, plan, lose continuity, repeat.

That changes how it feels to work together. Even a promising idea starts carrying the weight of previous attempts.

I don't think you need another plan. You need a different experience of working together.

Let's make the next interaction small and concrete: one task, actual execution, verified result. No architectural detours. No making you manage my process.

And if I hit a familiar pattern, I'll correct course rather than make you explain it again.
